scope: Read-only diagnosis and proposed design; no production or budget change

repository.message:
Merge pull request #11 from JJongAchii/quant-ai-company

fix: clarify background task status and record safe output failure causes

sourceFindings.fact: Fetches exact commit and tree; triage receives editable paths, not related current implementation bodies.
Reading is restricted by writable(path), coupling diagnostic reading to repair permissions.
Reads implementation files in patch after selecting a finding; existing payload snapshot is not refreshed at triage resumption.
History returns human/instruction requests and task results. Status reports thread cases; no cross-project repository/deployment/verification reconciliation or invalidation is supplied.
Unique problem_key reuses a case without recording a new occurrence/version; repeated findings can point at historical blocked/applied states.
Maintenance cap defaults to 6/day and schema accepts 1..12; director has no owner policy-change tool.

limits: Code inspection identifies missing evidence paths; it does not prove every incorrect model answer has one causal explanation.
No model call, live experiment, GitHub merge, server release or budget change was performed for this diagnosis.
ADR-0018 is a proposed implementation design, not implemented behavior.
